escena: SCENE (print review, post-production studio in Santiago, late afternoon): a single hard shaft of low sun cuts through half-open venetian blinds and lands directly ON THE MAN, raking across his shoulder and the side of his face while fine dust drifts inside the beam; he stands leaning over a lit lightbox table, holding a loupe down onto a strip of printed proofs for a specialty coffee brand's key visual, and he is lifting the loupe away mid-gesture at the exact moment he finds the flaw, his free hand holding an orange grease pencil. He is wearing a charcoal waffle-knit cotton sweater with the sleeves pushed up, no blue clothing of any kind. He looks down at the proofs, never at the camera. Behind him, well out of focus, a calibration monitor glows cool azure blue across the far wall of the room. 85mm lens at f/1.8, focus on his hands and the loupe. Everything is unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the matte black lid of a closed equipment flight case standing on a stool right against the lens, between the camera and the table, with nothing on it
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, with subtle texture and no highlights
